evidence.title: US average gasoline price drops below $3 a gallon for the first time since 2021
evidence.summary: This article directly states that the national average price for regular gasoline fell to $2.97 per gallon on December 9, 2024, the lowest since May 2021. It also mentions that additional downward pressure on gasoline prices will likely continue, with the national average potentially dropping another 10 to 15 cents by Christmas.

evidence.title: National Average Drops Below $3, First Time in 1,308 Days - GasBuddy
evidence.summary: This GasBuddy report confirms the national average price of gasoline fell below $3 per gallon on December 9, 2024, to $2.97 per gallon. It highlights this as the lowest level in over three years and notes a decline of 8.7 cents from a month ago and 17.7 cents per gallon lower than a year ago, indicating a clear downward trend in December.

evidence.title: U.S. National Average Price of Gas Falls To $2.99 Per Gallon, First Time in Over 1,300 Days
evidence.summary: This press release from GasBuddy states that the national average price of gas fell below $3 per gallon on December 2, 2024, to $2.999 per gallon. It also suggests that seasonal trends could potentially bring even lower prices this holiday season.

evidence.title: This Week In Petroleum Summary Printer-Friendly Version - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
evidence.summary: This EIA report, dated November 27, 2024, shows the U.S. average gasoline price at $3.044 per gallon, with a slight decrease of $0.002 from the previous week. This provides a baseline price point just before December and indicates a slight downward trend leading into the month.

evidence.title: National Average Falls to Lowest Since 2021; Next Stop, $2.99? - GasBuddy
evidence.summary: This GasBuddy report, published on December 2, 2024, states the national average price of gasoline stood at $3.00 per gallon, the lowest level since May 2021. It also notes a decline of 7.7 cents from a month ago and 23.2 cents per gallon lower than a year ago, reinforcing the downward trend.

evidence.title: In 2024, U.S. retail gasoline prices averaged about 20 cents less than in 2023 - U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
evidence.summary: This EIA analysis provides an overview of 2024 gasoline prices, stating that retail gasoline prices decreased to an annual low of $3.01/gal in early December and remained at a similar level through the rest of 2024. It also mentions that prices fell to their lowest since 2020 by Thanksgiving, indicating a strong downward momentum leading into December.

evidence.title: National Average Rises for First Time Since October; Still Below $3 - GasBuddy
evidence.summary: This GasBuddy report indicates a slight increase in the national average price of gasoline, climbing 0.8 cents to $2.98 per gallon. While still below $3, this represents a temporary reversal of the downward trend observed earlier in December.

evidence.title: National Average Returns to Decline, Back Below $3/gal - GasBuddy
evidence.summary: This GasBuddy report confirms that the national average price of gasoline declined again, falling 3.0 cents to $2.98 per gallon. This shows that despite a brief rise, the overall trend for December remained downward.
